integrity: The theorem is proved for all stated parameters in RESULT.md; two reproducible finite verification scripts and captured outputs are included. No formal or independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the one-marked Lagrangian oppositeness graph is addressed; identification against arbitrary graphs is not asserted.
For odd rank the strict fusion is relative to geometric intersection strata, not a separate characterization of the full graph automorphism group.
The matrix-count formulas and polar orbit structure are classical; the proposed new claim is the exact parity-sensitive counting-refinement outcome.
The printed computations are finite tests and do not replace the proof for all ranks and prime powers.
Priority remains subject to independent review, including possible implicit consequences of established polar association schemes.
title: Parity-fused counting refinement in symplectic oppositeness graphs
